status: Frozen before E4 execution; retrospective development on previously inspected experiments.
aim: Assess observation/calibration transport locally, by experiment x late temporal segment x input edge x training-defined fluorescence band; global summaries are contextual, not authority gates.
quantile_definition: Weighted empirical quantiles of current fluorescence at usable forecast origins in the four training experiments, equal total weight per experiment. Values at or below q10 are low; above q90 are high; others middle. No test-value selection of cuts.
edge: Programmed input at origin+offset-1 -> origin+offset; 00,01,10,11. Recorded known input, not inferred latent regulatory state.
local_gate: Require support in both early fit and validation subsets of the context (edge x band). Fit raw/offset/nonnegative-affine on early local data; choose lowest local validation MAE with ties raw,offset,affine. Activate correction only if relative early MAE gain exceeds 0.01. Refit chosen method on all local targets<=120. Otherwise keep raw, marked OUT_OF_SUPPORT when support absent. No threshold learning from late outcomes.
fixed_composition: Local equal-weight average of raw, local offset and local affine predictions; all evaluated on the same rows. If local calibration support unavailable, raw fallback with explicit status.
metrics: mean of largest ceil(0.05*n) absolute errors
labels: Per supported evaluation jurisdiction, observed MAE gain/loss versus raw using predeclared 1% descriptive relevance threshold; also full continuous changes and 0.1%/5% sensitivity. These are retrospective descriptive labels, not inferential significance or prospective authority. No Gaussian assumption. Unsupported evaluation is NOT_ESTIMABLE; insufficient calibration is OUT_OF_SUPPORT. Never impute absent jurisdictions.
dependence: Repeated trajectories/windows are not independent replicates; no independence-based p-values or confidence intervals. Local partitions must exactly reconstruct global case MAE, bias and MSE by observed counts.
failure_policy: Retain every jurisdiction and adverse outcome. Do not change partitions or support thresholds after results. No laboratory execution or commercial publication.
